title: Odeya Canonicalization Profile 0.1 to 0.2 Migration Candidate
description: Closed schema for the explicit, scoped, side-by-side migration candidate from the unissued odeya-jcs-0.1 profile bytes to the unissued odeya-jcs-0.2 product-identity successor. It forbids digest relabeling or inheritance, keeps all 120 predecessor-census resources explicit, treats unknown offline-resolution counts as null rather than zero, and cannot carry an issued profile, admitted schema resource, product digest, root, activation, runtime, publication, or external-effect grant.
